goal: Implement autonomous 24/7 Cloud Auto Trader execution engine with position normalization, multi-coin scanning, and trade closing in telegram_bot.py and supabase_client.py

function_signatures: run_cloud_auto_trader_cycle(sb: Any, notifier: TelegramNotifier, web_push: Optional[Any] = None, active_sessions: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None, binance_map: Optional[Dict[str, float]] = None, binance_24h: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]
normalize_cloud_position(pos: Dict[str, Any], default_capital: float = 50.0, default_sl_pct: float = 2.0) -> Dict[str, Any]

execution_steps: Write unit and integration tests in test_cloud_auto_trader.py verifying position normalization, breakout candidate selection, break-even arming, and trade closure
Run python test_cloud_auto_trader.py to verify failure of unhandled camelCase properties and trade closure tracking (red phase)
Implement normalize_cloud_position in telegram_bot.py supporting both camelCase and snake_case representations
Expand run_cloud_auto_trader_cycle in telegram_bot.py to evaluate all available symbols from BINANCE_SYMBOLS and record closed trades in bot_trades
Enhance supabase_client.py to support recording completed trades with closed status
Run python test_cloud_auto_trader.py to verify green phase
Run lint and typecheck verification commands
acceptance_criteria: normalize_cloud_position correctly parses positions formatted with camelCase and snake_case keys
run_cloud_auto_trader_cycle evaluates candidates from all active coins with live prices
run_cloud_auto_trader_cycle arms break-even when profit reaches +0.8%
run_cloud_auto_trader_cycle closes position and records trade when take profit (+2.0%) or stop loss (-2.0%) triggers

rollback.command: git checkout HEAD -- telegram_bot.py supabase_client.py; rm -f test_cloud_auto_trader.py contracts/TSK-CLOUD-006.contract.json
